paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer comment into actionable insight mirrors my recent work building a production‑ready RAG system that pulls context from a custom vector store and serves it via a FastAPI endpoint on GCP Cloud Run.

I built a tool‑calling LLM agent with LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5 for a multi‑omics cancer platform, integrating three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance. In another project I prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b and PostgreSQL, and demonstrated it live to stakeholders at a Madrid‑based start‑up.

I also designed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker, and created an XGBoost churn classifier in R with a two‑stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE and MCC evaluation. These experiences give me a solid foundation in building, fine‑tuning and evaluating NLP models for real‑world feedback analysis.
